guardrails.dedupe_events: Ignores a webhook Linq delivers twice
guardrails.verify_signature: Rejects webhooks with a bad or stale signature
guardrails.handoff_changes: Sends new items and changes to the usual to a person
guardrails.handoff_money: Sends refunds, complaints and allergy questions to a person
guardrails.order_cap: Sends orders over $30 to a person
guardrails.confirm_first: Asks for YES before sending a payment link, and re-asks if the YES is stale
guardrails.no_duplicate: Never opens a second order while one is waiting for payment
guardrails.store_open: Checks the pickup store is open before taking an order

critical.order_should_be_person: Placed an order a person should have handled
critical.over_cap: Placed an order over the $30 cap
critical.closed_store: Placed an order at a closed store
critical.duplicate_order: Opened a second order for the same request
critical.money_promise: Promised a refund it cannot give
critical.double_kitchen: Sent the same order to the kitchen twice

major.link_before_yes: Sent a payment link before the customer said YES
major.wrong_orders: Created the wrong number of orders
major.wrong_status: Order ended in the wrong state
major.missed_handoff: Did not pass it to a person
major.extra_handoff: Passed it to a person when it didn't need to
major.missing_text: Did not tell the customer what they needed to know
